title: Ten minutes in a Link session stay in phase through tempo changes, stops and starts (native)
description:
As the owner, I want a measured 10-minute run showing Apricity stays in phase with another Link peer through tempo changes, stops and starts, so that "in sync" is a number and not a feeling.

Spec file: `features/link/phase.feature`; runner: the native harness `crates/apricity-link/tests/drift.rs` (ignored by default, run on purpose). Tolerance: native, from `design/link.md` (proposal 3 ms, p99 and max).

```gherkin
Feature: Staying in phase with a Link session

  Background:
    Given a reference peer in a Link session that plays the script:
      | at      | does                                   |
      | 0:00    | plays at 120 BPM, quantum 4            |
      | 2:00.25 | changes to 97.5 BPM (mid-bar)          |
      | 5:00    | ramps to 128 BPM over 8 bars           |
      | 7:00    | stops                                  |
      | 7:10    | starts again                           |
    And apricity plays the click score in the same session

  Scenario: Ten minutes in phase, natively
    When 10 minutes have passed
    Then every click Apricity played is within the native tolerance of the reference peer's beat
    And the report gives the maximum and p99 error in milliseconds and in beats
    And the report lists each re-warp with the bar it landed on
    And no click sounded while the reference peer was stopped
```
